record.question: Upside down. Choose the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the idiom.
record.explanation: Answer B: in total disorder. “Upside down” can mean in disorder; “in total disorder” is the closest offered meaning. Independent check: “Upside down” can mean in a state of confusion or disorder; option B is the closest offered meaning. Reference: https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/upside%20down; https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/upside-down. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Exact printed question, choices and required directions/emphasis reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
